title: Scenario 8: Custom User-Agent Detection
description: Malware often uses custom or unusual User-Agent strings in HTTP requests. APT29 tools may use hardcoded or non-standard User-Agents.
mitre_technique: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
hunt_for: HTTP requests with non-standard User-Agent strings. Look for very old browser versions, custom agent names, or missing User-Agent headers.
kibana_query: user_agent:(*CustomAgent* OR *Python* OR *curl* OR *wget*) AND NOT user_agent:*Mozilla*
detection_tips: Look for non-browser User-Agents (Python, curl, custom)
Check for User-Agents that don't match user's actual browser
key_indicators: Very short or very long User-Agents
